synthesis.evidence_balance: mixed — growing revenue/subs and a contractual margin step-up against negative FCF, a -37% EBITDA revision and a forward-EBITDA premium.

bull_points.claim: The stock's optical valuation collapse (-79% one-year vs +31% for its small-cap benchmark) is not a revenue story: LTM revenue rose to $5,712M from $4,413M as the Hulu + Live TV combination scaled the business, so the drawdown is a re-rating of profitability, not a collapse in the top line.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Income Statement (margin % + absolute EBITDA reconciler)

bull_points.claim: Management points to a contractual step-up in the wholesale fee vs Hulu + Live TV carriage costs — 95% in calendar 2026 scaling to 99% by 2028 — as a mechanical driver of forward adjusted-EBITDA expansion, a source-bound operating lever rather than a bare hope.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ transcript: FuboTV Inc., Q2 2026 Earnings Call, May 06, 2026.rtf

bull_points.claim: The advertising migration to Disney's ad server is already producing double-digit increases in CPM and fill rates versus last year, a concrete monetization mechanism behind the forward margin build.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ transcript: FuboTV Inc., Q3 2026 Earnings Call, Aug 05, 2026.rtf

bull_points.claim: Subscribers are stable-to-growing — 5.75 million in North America in Q3 2026, up 2% year-over-year — so the paying base underpinning the forward EBITDA ramp is not eroding.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ transcript: FuboTV Inc., Q3 2026 Earnings Call, Aug 05, 2026.rtf

bull_points.claim: The ESPN 'Where to Watch' referral channel is converting free-trial users to paid at a higher rate than other channels with favorable early retention, a new low-cost acquisition mechanism.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ transcript: FuboTV Inc., Q3 2026 Earnings Call, Aug 05, 2026.rtf

bull_points.claim: On a headline TEV/Revenue basis the name trades at 0.4x vs a peer median of 2.0x, and the fundamental_deltas show name revenue growth of 31% vs a peer-median 8% — the human must judge whether that discount is EARNED (no EBITDA margin, negative FCF) or RESIDUAL given superior growth, noting the peer set is flagged HETEROGENEOUS so the median is not a clean benchmark.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Comparable Analysis→Operating Statistics (name vs peer median: growth/margin/leverage/beta)

bull_points.claim: Sell-side posture remains constructive: consensus rating Buy (1.00) with a mean/median target of $17.00 against a ~$9.70 last close, a gap the human must weigh against the deteriorating estimate path.

bear_points.claim: The business does not self-fund: LTM levered free cash flow is -$107.8M and CIQ operating cash flow is -$456M, so it is burning cash while carrying $172.5M of net debt — the survival leg is FCF-negative with cash-runway visibility not derivable here.
bear_points.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Cash Flow 'Levered Free Cash Flow' [12 months Sep-27-2025]

bear_points.claim: The FY2026 EBITDA consensus has been cut sharply during the year — from $150.0M (9-months-ago) to $95.2M latest, net -37% — so the very forward profitability the bull case rests on is being marked down, not up.
bear_points.source_ref: CIQ Estimates→Trends (current-FY consensus path; ragged, absent lookbacks n/a)

bear_points.claim: FY2026 GAAP EPS consensus has crossed from positive to negative over the year (+1.68 nine-months-ago → -1.21 latest), and every GAAP profitability line (EBIT, EBT, net income) has 'worsened (crossed zero)', signalling the profitability inflection has slipped, not arrived.
bear_points.source_ref: CIQ Estimates→Trends (current-FY consensus path; ragged, absent lookbacks n/a)

bear_points.claim: The optical 'cheap' NTM read reverses on EBITDA: name NTM TEV/EBITDA is 16.19x vs a peer median of 9.87x — on forward earnings power the name is at a PREMIUM, not a discount, so the TEV/Rev cheapness is the consensus MISREAD once the missing margin is priced.
bear_points.source_ref: CIQ Comparable Analysis→Trading Multiples (name row + Summary Statistics Low/Median/Mean/High)

bear_points.claim: Returns on capital are structurally negative and barely improving (ROIC -11.2% → -10.9% → -10.7% across FY23→FY25), so the business has not historically earned its cost of capital even before the recent burn.
bear_points.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Ratios (Return on Capital %, multi-year columns)

bear_points.claim: Near-term revision breadth is decisively negative — FQ4 2026 Revenue 0↑/8↓ and EBITDA 0↑/7↓ across all lookbacks — with brokers (BTIG, Raymond James, Barrington) slashing FQ4 EBITDA estimates into negative territory around the August print.
The equity is being diluted (~+2.5% share count over ~0.7yr) while carrying a $177.5M 2029 convertible and a $145M Disney note, so existing holders face ongoing dilution alongside the debt load.
The three drawdown legs are discrete gap-downs on earnings prints (2026-05-06 and 2026-08-06, both item 2.02), indicating the market repriced on results rather than a transient macro shock.
bear_points.source_ref: EDGAR 8-K item codes at the gap-down dates (not blanket-labelled earnings)

twin_reference_cases.distinguishing_fact: A US streaming-platform peer in the same roster that ran deeply unprofitable on a headline basis while growing revenue, then re-rated as advertising monetization and scale drove EBITDA positive — the pattern the Disney-ad-server thesis needs to repeat.
twin_reference_cases.source: CIQ Comparable Analysis→Financial Data + Business Description (roster + caps + business)

twin_reference_cases.name: Paramount Skydance Corporation
twin_reference_cases.distinguishing_fact: A roster peer in legacy media that carried heavy acquired-intangible balances and took a very large goodwill write-down, illustrating the value-trap path where a media combination's carrying value proves unrecoverable.
twin_reference_cases.source: CIQ Comparable Analysis→Financial Data + Operating Statistics (per-peer grid) · as-of 2026-08-12

twin_reference_cases.name: Starz Entertainment Corp.
twin_reference_cases.distinguishing_fact: The smallest roster peer, a subscription video programmer that wrote down more than its entire acquired base amid structural subscriber pressure — the cord-cutting-erosion analogue for a single-segment video business.

twin_reference_cases.name: Sirius XM Holdings Inc.
twin_reference_cases.distinguishing_fact: A subscription-media peer that generated positive EBITDA yet still took multi-billion goodwill impairment as subscriber growth stalled, showing profitability alone does not guarantee the acquired value holds.

twin_reference_cases.name: Chewy
twin_reference_cases.distinguishing_fact: A high-revenue-growth, thin-margin US consumer platform that was priced as a cash-burner during a drawdown, then re-rated once operating leverage turned free cash flow positive — the mean-revert template for a growth-with-no-margin name.

decisive_question.question: Does the contractual wholesale-fee step-up plus Disney ad-server monetization convert the growing subscriber base into the forward adjusted-EBITDA ramp (and eventual positive FCF) fast enough to outrun the current cash burn and dilution — or does the negative FCF, deteriorating consensus and negative ROIC mark this as a structurally unprofitable single-segment vMVPD?

evidence_for.claim: Management cites a wholesale fee at 95% of Hulu + Live TV carriage costs in 2026 scaling to 99% by 2028 as giving 'strong visibility' into adjusted-EBITDA expansion — a contractual, dated mechanism.
evidence_for.source_ref: CIQ transcript: FuboTV Inc., Q2 2026 Earnings Call, May 06, 2026.rtf

evidence_for.claim: Double-digit CPM and fill-rate gains from the Disney ad-server migration are already observed, evidencing the monetization lever is live and not merely projected.
evidence_for.source_ref: CIQ transcript: FuboTV Inc., Q3 2026 Earnings Call, Aug 05, 2026.rtf

evidence_for.claim: Consensus still models a steep EBITDA ramp (FY26E $95.2M → FY27E $175.8M) and FCF guidance of $0.00 for FY2027, implying the burn is expected to end.
evidence_for.source_ref: CIQ Estimates→Trends (FY26E/FY27E consensus EBITDA, latest snapshot)

evidence_against.claim: LTM levered FCF is -$107.8M and CIQ OCF is -$456M against $172.5M net debt — the company is currently consuming cash, and both self-funding inputs are negative.
evidence_against.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Cash Flow 'Levered Free Cash Flow' [12 months Sep-27-2025]

evidence_against.claim: The same FY2026 EBITDA anchor has been cut -37% over the year (from $150.0M to $95.2M) as GAAP earnings lines crossed back below zero, so the ramp keeps getting pushed out.
evidence_against.source_ref: CIQ Estimates→Trends (current-FY consensus path; ragged, absent lookbacks n/a)

evidence_against.claim: On forward EBITDA the name is at a premium (NTM TEV/EBITDA 16.19x vs peer median 9.87x), so it is not cheap on the metric that captures the profitability thesis.
evidence_against.source_ref: CIQ Comparable Analysis→Trading Multiples (name row + Summary Statistics Low/Median/Mean/High)

key_unknowns: Cash runway: the FCF/OCF figures are negative but cash-burn duration is not derivable here — the survival_capacity leg is flagged 'cash not derived — a risk' (an opacity that skews bearish until resolved).

No CIQ Net Debt/EBITDA and no interest-coverage ratio are available (Income Statement missing EBITDA or Interest Expense row; EDGAR no net-debt) — leverage sustainability cannot be judged on any disclosed basis.

Company-adjusted LTM EBITDA and margins are not in the revised guidance, so the gap between management's 'pro forma adjusted EBITDA >$100M TTM' framing and the negative GAAP/consensus GAAP picture is unreconciled here.
TEV/multiple vintage is flagged incoherent (derived FY26 $19.3M vs direct $95.2M, residual 0.797) — comps should be re-pulled before leaning on any TEV-based figure.
The peer set is HETEROGENEOUS (market caps $410M–$311.4B, 759x span; name $293M) — every peer multiple is a confidence-gated input, not a clean benchmark.
The customer list is dated 2015-era 10-K references and single-segment reporting gives no segment-EBITDA breakout — no independent view of where the profit (or loss) sits inside the combined vMVPD.
New CEO (first earnings call Aug 2026) has yet to formalize strategy/pricing; a strategic update is promised for the November print — execution risk on an unproven plan.
